description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PatientDataVoidHandler class in the OpenMRS project. It tests voiding patient data such as encounters, observations, orders, and cohort memberships within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: PatientDataVoidHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the voiding functionality of PatientDataVoidHandler in OpenMRS.

methods.name: handle_shouldVoidTheOrdersEncountersAndObservationsAssociatedWithThePatient
methods.description: Tests that the handle method correctly voids all encounters, observations, and orders linked to a patient.

methods.name: handle_shouldVoidCohortMemberships
methods.description: Tests that the handle method correctly voids cohort memberships when a patient is voided.
